questions.question: Paul thanked God for the believers he wrote to. What had he heard about them?

answers.text: Their faith in the Lord Jesus and their love for all the saints
Their courage in prison and their gifts to the poor in Jerusalem
Their bold preaching in the city and their care for widows

questions.question: Paul prayed that God would give the believers he wrote to a spirit of wisdom and revelation. In what?

answers.text: In their plans for the year ahead
In their dealings with city leaders

questions.question: Paul wrote that God used His mighty strength in Christ. What did God do?

answers.text: Raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand
Kept Him safe from every enemy He faced on the earth
Carried Him up to heaven in a chariot of fire
